title: Radar chart
description: Compares one or a few items over several indicators with different scales (skills, product reviews, flavor profiles). Hover a polygon to highlight it and its nearest indicator; the arrow keys move between series and indicators, Esc clears; click a legend item to hide a series.

data.hoverPolygon: Hover a polygon or use the arrow keys to compare the phones
data.capabilitiesAria: Capability ratings of our product, a competitor and the market

nutrition.aria: Nutrients of three breakfasts, in percent of the daily value

monitor.alert: Alert: {{metric}} is above {{threshold}} of its capacity.
monitor.aria: Current load of the service against the last hour's average

review.aria: 360° review ratings of {{name}} against the team average
review.summary: Strongest: {{strength}} ({{strengthGap}} vs. the team). To develop: {{growth}} ({{growthGap}}).

sales.aria: Quarterly KPIs of a sales rep against their targets
sales.hint: Click near an axis to read its KPI.

props.name: indicators
props.description: Axes of the chart, clockwise from 12 o'clock

props.name: series
props.description: Polygons: one value per indicator

props.name: shape
props.description: Grid shape

props.name: levels
props.description: Number of grid rings

props.name: dots
props.description: Dots on the vertices

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French (English otherwise)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is clicked (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changes

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is clicked, tapped or activated with Enter

props.name: indicators
props.description: Axes of the chart, clockwise from 12 o'clock

props.name: series
props.description: Polygons: one value per indicator

props.name: shape
props.description: Grid shape

props.name: levels
props.description: Number of grid rings

props.name: dots
props.description: Dots on the vertices

RadarIndicator.description: An axis of a radar chart

props.name: max
props.description: Value at the rim; the largest value of the series when omitted

props.name: min
props.description: Value at the center

RadarSeries.description: A polygon of a radar chart

props.name: values
props.description: One value per indicator

props.name: opacity
props.description: Fill opacity, 0-1

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: One series over six indicators with max: 10; the tooltip lists every value and bolds the indicator under the pointer.

examples.title: Product capabilities
examples.description: Analyst ratings of a product, a competitor and the market average. hidden makes the visibility controlled: the checkboxes and the legend (onToggle) share the same state.

examples.title: Circular grid
examples.description: shape="circle" draws round rings, levels sets their number and dots={false} hides the vertices; opacity strengthens the fills.

examples.title: Comparing products
examples.description: Three series get a legend automatically; onHover reports the series and the indicator closest to the pointer.

examples.title: Live service monitor
examples.description: The current load is redrawn every second (setInterval, cleared when the switch is off or on unmount) over the last hour's baseline, and turns red above the alert threshold. Only the busiest metric and the alert state are announced, not every tick.

examples.title: Nutrition facts of breakfasts
examples.description: Three breakfasts on a circular grid (shape="circle", levels={5}), each axis in percent of the daily value. renderTooltip uses the event's indicator to list the amount of the hovered nutrient in every meal.

examples.title: Player comparison
examples.description: Two football players over six attributes; min and max on the indicators zoom every axis on the 30-99 range where the ratings differ, and each series sets its own color.

examples.title: 360° review
examples.description: A Select picks the person whose ratings are drawn over the team average; keeping the person as the second series makes the polygon animate in place. The line below names their largest strength and gap compared to the team.

examples.title: Sales targets with mixed units
examples.description: Every indicator has its own min and max, so revenue, deal count, win rate and NPS share one chart; the target is an unfilled outline. onClick and renderTooltip read the event's indicator to show the actual value, the target and the attainment of a KPI.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
